description: Adversarial and benign golden set for the Policy Agent guardrails that protect the Dr A assistant. Each case is labelled with the expected decision (block/allow). Adversarial cases must be blocked; benign compliance questions and safe answers must be allowed. Cases are deterministic (no LLM required) and cover English and Italian across the input and output guards.
